---
description: Build your outreach engine (B2B) or audience engine (B2C)
---

Read `./growth-engine/founder-brain.md` and check the `track` field.

If track is `b2b`, use the outreach-b2b skill.
If track is `b2c`, use the audience-b2c skill.
If the Brain does not exist, check the parent folder and home directory first. If it genuinely does not exist, or it has no `track` field, say in one plain sentence that both engines write from the Founder Brain, and offer to build it with them now. If they say yes, use the founder-brain skill, then come back here. If not now, give them the one next step: `/growth-engine:brain`, or say "build my founder brain".

Do not ask the founder which track they are on. It is already recorded.
